snippet.title: House Flipper 2 Pets DLC reveal - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
As if decorating wasn't already chaotic enough, now your cat can knock things off the counter. A new region, more houses, and lots of furry (and scaly) friends are coming to the game next year.
